This is resolution number R-22-2022. There are two separate proposals within the resolution. One is to fix sidewalks within the corporate limits of the town, on town maintained sidewalks. The second proposal is to maintain or to repair sidewalks within the town that are on what would be classified as county or state sidewalks. Under the current situation, the state and county defer to the town, to the locality for repair of sidewalks. So that's why we had them do two separate proposals. So the town would be aware of what was being cost directly to the town on our maintained sidewalks. And in addition to the ones that would be on like Summit Avenue or some areas of the University Boulevard, compared to what we would do on our regular residential streets. In addition, there are a number of sidewalks proposed that are outside the corporate limits. We are aware of that. And we plan on addressing that with the contractor directly to have them removed from the proposal. And Precision Concrete is a contractor that we did two previous times in the town. And this requires an extra majority vote from the council, because there was no bid for this project.
